div.div:
Flow
① Browser → Cloudflare edge (HTTPS)
② Cloudflare edge → Cloud Run (HTTPS)
③ Cloud Run → Supabase PostgreSQL (SQL)
④ Cloud Run → Cloudflare R2 (S3 API)
⑤ Cloud Run → Resend (HTTPS)
⑥ Cloud Run → Sentry (HTTPS)
⑦ Cloud Run → Secret Manager (mounts secrets)
⑧ Cloud Scheduler → Cloud Run (every minute)
⑨ GitHub Actions → GHCR (builds the image)
⑩ GHCR → Cloud Run (deploys the image)
